components.name: Primary Verify Button
components.description: Primary verification trigger across both workbenches.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(99.4% 0.002 250); background: oklch(48% 0.175 256); border: 1px solid oklch(48% 0.175 256); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(42% 0.175 256); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(48% 0.175 256); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Numeric Bound Input
components.description: Strict base-10 integer bound input with high-contrast 3:1 control border.
components.css: .ds-input-num { height: 32px; width: 84px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(19.5% 0.018 255); background: oklch(99.4% 0.002 250); border: 1px solid oklch(59% 0.025 252); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-input-num:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(48% 0.175 256); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: RuleCanvasKit is an engineering verification suite for discrete finite-state transition systems. Its visual language combines a high-density functional workbench architecture with restrained editorial typography, thin 1px structural rules, mathematical proposition clarity, and domain-honest state visualization.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-delimited panes (1px solid) instead of floating card stacks.
Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans for interface prose and IBM Plex Mono (tabular-nums) strictly for identifiers, expressions, state values, step counters, and bounds.
Semantic color reserved for primary verification actions and formal engine verdicts.
Persistent System default theme (with Light fallback) plus explicit Light and Dark overrides synchronized across workbenches.

rules.name: The One-Signal Verdict Rule
rules.body: Semantic green, amber, and crimson appear only when tied to an engine-derived verification verdict, invariant evaluation, transition guard state, or validation error.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono exclusively for formal identifiers, expressions, state values, numeric bounds, and step indices.

rules.name: The Zero-Card-Nesting Rule
rules.body: Never place a bordered, shadowed card inside another bordered card. Separate peer sections inside a pane with 1px solid hairlines and whitespace.

dos: Do self-host only the required Latin WOFF2 subsets (400, 500, 600) of IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono alongside OFL.txt with zero external CDN requests.
Do pair every status color with an explicit symbol and text label and maintain >= 4.5:1 text contrast and >= 3:1 control border contrast in both Light and Dark themes.
Do bind every displayed verdict, trace step, schematic readout, and assumption list strictly to its verified snapshot.
donts: Don't nest bordered cards inside cards, add decorative left-border accent stripes on rounded boxes, or use glowing shadows.
Don't place tracked-out uppercase eyebrows above headings or wrap static subtitles in pill badges.
Don't label an outdated replay snapshot as Live or conflate step-local invariant satisfaction with model-wide VERIFIED status.
